notes.title: Downloads and notifications (☰)
notes.text: The ☰ button at the top right of the label preview lists every PDF and Excel file you saved, with Open, Print and Show in folder, and keeps notifications (labels saved, low Shree Anjani AWBs, gate problems, partner updates) until you clear them.

notes.title: BoxUp print preview
notes.text: Print opens a Chrome-style preview: choose the printer (TSC TE310 for labels), pages, copies and paper size 4 x 6. Tick Remember to keep the printer and paper for labels.

notes.title: Open PDFs inside the app
notes.text: Open shows the PDF in a BoxUp window with the Chrome PDF viewer.

notes.title: Check for update in the File menu
notes.text: File > Check for update (Ctrl+U) looks at GitHub and brings down the newest label tool straight away.

notes.title: The old template no longer comes back
notes.text: The app now keeps the newest copy of the tool, not the last one it happened to download.

notes.title: About shows both versions
notes.text: Help > About BoxUp Labels lists what is installed here and what is on GitHub right now, and says whether they match.
